oracle_output.summary: Adds a new terminal.overlay token for solid modal surfaces, standardizes z-index hierarchy across components (tooltips 100, drawers 200/210, modals 300/310, critical alerts 400/410, toasts 500), extracts shared Launchpad color constants to eliminate hardcoded values, and fixes AlertPanel backdrop transparency.
key_claims: Added terminal.overlay color token (#121417) to tailwind.config.js for solid modal/drawer surfaces

Replaced bg-terminal-panel with bg-terminal-overlay on 9 overlay components including BreachesModal, ReplayDrawer, CompareSidebar, GhostForks, AlertPanel, and 3 each in MarketplacePage and BlackboxPage
Fixed AlertPanel backdrop from fully transparent to bg-black/40
Standardized z-index values: tooltips z-100, drawers z-200/210, modals z-300/310, critical alerts z-400/410, toasts z-500
Created constants/launchpad.ts file with PHASE_COLORS, CATEGORY_COLORS, and getQualityColor function as single source of truth
Replaced 11 hardcoded #22D3EE instances and 3 #9932CC instances in LaunchpadNewPage with echelon-cyan and status-paradox tokens
Updated CSS z-index values: .modal-backdrop from 9990 to 300, .modal-content from 9995 to 310
Added launch success toast via demoStore.pushToast on draft creation in LaunchpadNewPage
Updated LaunchCardMini, LaunchpadDetailPage, and LaunchpadRail to use unified PHASE_COLORS and CATEGORY_COLORS
